3.6L PENTASTAR® HAS THE BRAWN TO GET YOU AHEAD OF THE PACK, AND KEEP YOU THERE.
Fuel-economy improvements of nearly 11 percent
compared to the previous Pentastar generation
add even more value. The engine’s increased
efficiencies are helped by the addition of Engine
Stop/ Start (ESS) technology, while it remains a
brawny performer, boasting 285 horsepower and
260 lb-ft of torque. Available with a 6-speed manual
or 8-speed automatic transmission.
285 ENGINE STOP / START TECHNOLOGY (ESS) Say hello
horsepower to this new feature on the 3.6L Pentastar engine.
Its job is to help reduce C02 emissions and improve
260 efficiency by using a dual-battery system and
lb-ft of torque sophisticated controls to reduce fuel flow and turn
off the engine when the vehicle brakes to a stop. When
the brake or clutch pedal is released, the engine
seamlessly restarts and the transmission engages.
2.0L TURBO I-4 ENGINE
This all-new engine performs with V6 muscle, yet
sips fuel as an I-4 should. The 2.0L Turbo I-4 engine
steps into a new world by offering fuel-saving/energy-
generating functions that include auto-stop/start,
electric power assist, extended fuel shutoff,
transmission shift management, intelligent battery
charging and regenerative braking. Direct injection
boosts power while reducing emissions, and ESS
technology improves fuel economy. It’s a perfect
match of superior strength teamed up with welcome
modern efficiencies. With its standard match to the
new 8-speed transmission, you’ll enjoy strong takeoffs
and smooth highway coasting.
ESS operates behind the scenes, virtually unnoticed,
to help reduce fuel consumption by automatically
270 shutting down the engine while stopped at traffic
horsepower lights and highway snarls. It then restarts when the
driver releases the brake or clutch pedal or presses
295 on the accelerator pedal. Optimal powertrain
lb-ft of torque efficiencies are realized by managing transmission
shift schedules according to individual driving styles.
No worries about running down the battery power
when the engine is off — an auxiliary electricity
source operates accessories, such as heater and
A/C blower fan, audio system, wipers and headlights.
